title: Data model for a Biocorner bio-based mortar product
description: CIRCULOOS data model for a Biocorner bio-based mortar product formulation, covering its classification by secondary raw material source, its application guidelines and the Declaration of Performance that certifies it.

object.description: URN of the referenced entity, with the format urn:ngsi-ld:<type>:<id>.

id.description: Property. Unique entity identifier, with the format urn:ngsi-ld:MortarProduct:<id>.

type.description: Property. NGSI Entity type. It has to be MortarProduct

name.description: Property. Commercial or project-internal product name used to identify this formulation within the product portfolio.

description.description: Property. Technical description of the product including primary bio-based components, key performance characteristics, and intended application domain.

classification.description: Property. Product classification based on the primary secondary raw material used in the formulation. Enables grouping and comparison by SRM source type.

applicationGuidelines.description: Property. Technical guidance for product application including suitable substrates, recommended application parameters, ambient conditions, and curing requirements.

certifiedBy.description: Relationship. Relationship to the DoP entity containing the performance declaration for this product. Links the product to its regulatory compliance documentation.

productionRegion.description: Property. Geographic region where the product is manufactured. Used for regional supply chain analysis and local economic impact assessment.

country.description: Property. The country where the product is manufactured.

dateCreated.description: Property. Date at which the entity was created.
